notes:
Summary: Kepler Plugin Studio builds a JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that provides local code completions and an offline-aware assistant. Interested in Redwood for consistent low-latency streaming, model/version pinning, and a private deployment path for customers that require on-prem or VPC-only installs.

Recent activity:
- 2024-10-08 discovery call (Jordan P. + Kepler engineering lead Maya Liu). basic requirements captured.
- 2024-10-22 technical deep-dive with SE (Ravi). demoed Redwood streaming in hosted env, then ran local-index prototype.
- 2024-11-05 POC kickoff: installed dedicated instance in Kepler test VPC; initial throughput tests completed.
- 2024-11-12 live demo (internal stakeholders) — achieved sub-50ms token latency in small repo, outlier spikes with monorepo. ff meeting id ff_2024_poc_demo_7243.

Requirements and constraints (customer language / notes):
- "Must work offline or behind corporate VPN for sensitive repos" — strong on-prem/VPC requirement.
- Local indexing for private code with periodic sync to a private embeddings/lookup store; must support retention controls and easy purge.
- Model pinning: customers want explicit pinned model per plugin release, predictable behavior across updates.
- Streaming completions with per-token latency <80ms target for completion UX in IDE; also want graceful fallback to smaller model if dedicated capacity saturated.
- Cost sensitivity: early customers (ISV plugin buyers) expect predictable pricing — interested in Optimize recommendations for batching & quantization to lower TCO.

Security/procurement notes:
- Legal sent NDA (Kepler-NDA-v3), security team requested SOC2 + KMS integration details. Need to provide security FAQ and network diagram.
- Asked about SAML SSO flow specifically for JetBrains plugin activation + license checks.

POC scope and results to-date:
- Local index built using a lightweight extractor (on-device) + secure sync to a private embeddings service in VPC. Latency at 30-50ms for cold completions on small modules.
- Observed throughput drop when indexing large monorepo; suspect batching kernel selection and KV-cache tuning needed on Redwood runtime.
- Model pinning prototype works: pinned gpt-like-open-8b quantized; need to test A/B rollout and rollback behavior.

Next steps (short):
- SE to run model-pinning + streaming stress test across a 10k-file monorepo (action owner: Ravi, due: 2024-11-29).
- Provide security FAQ + network diagram (owner: Jordan, due: 2024-11-20).
- Schedule SAML SSO session with Kepler identity team (owner: Lena, tentative: 2024-11-25).

Sales notes / signals:
- Kepler has an active pipeline of enterprise plugin customers; 3 pilots expected H1 next year. If POC meets latency + security, high conversion likelihood.
- Primary blockers: SSO edge cases, EU data residency language in contract, and proof of stable perf at scale.
